text:
marta: Heads-up — we need approved capacity to provision H100 + L4 GPUs in a new GCP project (redwood-infer-staging-2) for the model migration next week. Preflight + asks below. Anyone from infra able to sign off?

sanjay: Do we have the billing account attached to that project yet? GCP won't increase quotas without it.

elaine: Billing linked -> billing-account: 123456-ABC. Project number: 987654321012. I also created a service account `infra-provisioner@redwood-infer-staging-2.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

praveen: Thanks. Quick checklist I need before I file the quota request:
- region(s): us-west1 and us-central1
- accelerators: H100 (A100-equivalent fallback: A100 80GB) and L4
- target counts: us-west1: H100 x4, L4 x8; us-central1: L4 x6 for burst
- expected start date: 2026-04-08
- VPC peering + egress IPs confirmed?

marta: VPC peering planned, need EIP pool: 30 static IPs across the two regions.

gcp-sre: Can you paste the exact quota metric names? I'll prepare the SR.

praveen: Sure — metrics we request in the quota UI: `NVIDIA_TESLA_H100_LOCAL_SSD` (region accelerator quota), `GPUS_ALL_REGIONS` (project-level), and `L4_ACCELERATORS`. Also request `IN_USE_ADDRESSES` bump to +30 in each region.

elaine: Here's the quick commands I ran for current state: 
```
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-infer-staging-2
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=redwood-infer-staging-2
gcloud compute addresses list --project=redwood-infer-staging-2 --regions=us-west1,us-central1
```
Output shows zero GPUs allocated currently.

marta: Cost note: expected steady-state usage ~ 2 H100 and 6 L4 across stg; peak burst to the requested counts during load tests. Rough monthly estimate: $35k for burst capacity if fully used; actual committed use will be lower. Keep finance in the loop.

sanjay: For approvals: who signs the GCP quota SR? ops_lead or infra oncall? ops_lead is listed as approver for new projects.

ops_lead: I can approve the project-level changes once the SR has the attached cost estimate and the VPC peering ticket number.

praveen: Filing SR now. Draft body: "Request increase of GPU accelerators in us-west1 and us-central1 for project redwood-infer-staging-2 (proj:987654321012). Need H100=4 (us-west1), L4=14 total (8 us-west1, 6 us-central1), increase IN_USE_ADDRESSES +60 across both regions. Purpose: model migration / load test, timeframe 2026-04-08 to 2026-04-22. Billing account 123456-ABC. Contact: praveen@redwood.com, infra oncall."

marta: LGTM. Add a fallback note to allow A100 80GB if H100 capacity unavailable in time. Also request temporary burst quota policy to allow cross-region fallback to eu-west1 if us-west1 constrained.

gcp-sre: SR created: SR-20260401-9876. GCP ticket references: [https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/SR-20260401-9876]. Included the fallback and egress IP ask.

infra-bot: automated: "SR-20260401-9876 status=OPEN assignee=GCP Support team" :gear:

praveen: Filed the internal approval form linking ops_lead and finance. @ops_lead can you confirm once you sign?

ops_lead: Reviewing now — small question on the IP count. Why +60? earlier you said 30.

marta: Sorry — math error. We only need 30 total static IPs (not 60). Please correct the SR.

praveen: Updated SR description to request +30 static IPs across the two regions, not +60. Noted in SR comments.

gcp-sre: GCP replied: "We can provision L4 quota within 24-48h. H100 availability in us-west1 is limited; alternate approval might route to a capacity region. We'll keep SR open and propose A100 fallback."

elaine: I updated the deployment plan to include model quantization fallback for A100 if H100 not available — we can reduce tokens and batch size.

marta: Good. Once GCP approves L4 we can land the VPC peering and static IPs, then smoke test with L4 before the migration.

ops_lead: Signed internal approval. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: automated: "SR-20260401-9876 status=UPDATED note=GCP approved L4 quota in us-west1/central; H100 pending availability; SR assigned priority=HIGH"

praveen: Can someone confirm the project IAM for the `infra-provisioner` SA has `compute.admin` and `serviceusage.quotaAdmin`?

elaine: Confirmed: infra-provisioner has compute.admin, serviceusage.quotaAdmin, and compute.networkAdmin for peering.

marta: Ok — next steps: 1) Wait for GCP H100 update (maybe approve A100 fallback), 2) Allocate 30 static IPs and finish VPC peering, 3) Run smoke tests with L4, 4) Migration window 2026-04-08.

sanjay: Noting cost owner: tagging with `cost-center:platform-research` so finance can attribute.

gcp-sre: Closing note: keep SR-20260401-9876 open until H100 decision final. I've added a contact in the GCP ticket for @praveen.

marta: Great work everyone — thanks. :thumbsup: If H100 fails, we'll proceed with A100 fallback and adjust batch config.

infra-bot: automated: "thread archived after 7 days of inactivity"
